payload.title: One seat ref outside the evidence grammar makes _mint_arbiter raise inside dispatch_arbiter_for_split_verdicts with no per-group containment, so that group is retried first on every cycle and every later group of the tool is never arbitrated.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1013-1045 (the loop mints group after group with no per-group handler; a raise leaves minted_inputs unchanged, so the same group fails first on the next cycle)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:1075-1101 (every seat ref is unioned into create_agent_invocation_request)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:1796-1806 (a ref outside the grammar raises GovernanceError request_evidence_not_agent_citable)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:2198-2206 (the caller contains the GovernanceError per tool and records one blocked entry, so every later group of that tool is skipped)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/evidence_trust.py:451-452 (the grammar excludes whitespace, <, > and the backtick)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:885-886 (record_operator_feedback accepts any non-empty strings as evidence_refs, so a row with such a ref can be stored)
payload.rule_violated: Failure isolation per judgment group: one malformed group must not stop the arbiter for the rest of the tool (compare ORPHAN-HIGH-578, the same class in the learning hooks).
payload.notes: A judge row whose evidence_refs holds a string with whitespace, a tag delimiter or a backtick is storable (a row recorded before the grammar hardened, or written directly). _mint_arbiter unions that ref into the arbiter request and create_agent_invocation_request raises request_evidence_not_agent_citable; the exception leaves dispatch_arbiter_for_split_verdicts, cycle.py records one blocked entry for the whole tool, and because the group never reaches minted_inputs it fails first again every cycle while every group sorted after it is never minted. Pre-existing and unchanged by J3 (the base mints through the same call with the same refs). The submit gate refuses such refs in new answers, so a stored legacy or directly written row is needed; the live ledger was not inspected. Close condition: dispatch_arbiter_for_split_verdicts contains a mint failure per group (the group is reported in skipped with the named reason and the loop continues), and a test with two owed groups, the first holding a seat ref with a newline and a backtick, asserts the second is still minted and the skip is reported. Plan row: J3 (the F0.7 exit). Verified at head 3451f5c3fc of open pull request #2135; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
